Deals.title: Pipeline
Deals.body: The pipeline shows your open deals as columns per stage, with the weighted total in the header. A card changes stage through its stage picker; won or lost runs through its own closing step, with a reason collected on a loss. With no open deals the total shows a dash rather than a fabricated zero.
